budget.rule: Crowd DPS = ATK × SPD × targets. The budget sets crowd DPS by weight; ATK is derived and never hand-tuned.

weights.Scaler: 30 at the bell, 40 at full stacks

emerald.heat: +4 whenever any ally takes a hit

gems.name: Ruby
gems.job: Kill things, fast. The Striker is the table’s knife.
gems.keywordDef: Burn: 6 damage per second per stack for 4 s, max 3 stacks. Burn ticks ignore ARM.
gems.heat: +5 Heat per kill on top of the base gains.

oxp.passive: Every combo leaves a Burn on the monster worth 15% of the damage dealt, paid at the start of the next turn and ignoring Defense. A second Ruby seat makes it 20%, a third 25%.

gems.name: Sapphire
gems.job: Get hit instead of everyone else. The Warden is the table itself.
gems.keywordDef: Chill: −20% SPD per stack; 3 stacks = Freeze for 1.5 s. Shields are temporary HP that take damage first.
gems.heat: +4 Heat per hit taken on top of the base gains.

oxp.limit: ×1.5, and the seat may recolour the action it committed after seeing the others.
oxp.passive: The party starts every encounter with a Ward of 30 over its Nerve; Counter hits the Ward first, and every kill refreshes it. A second Sapphire seat makes it 45, a third 60.

gems.name: Emerald
gems.job: Keep the table standing and scale as the fight goes on. The Mender is the pot that never empties.
gems.keywordDef: Grow: a permanent stack for the rest of the fight (HMD) or the run (OXP). Grow never decays.
gems.lean: +15% max HP, +1% HP regen per second, −5% ATK. Healing generates 1.5× threat.
gems.heat: +4 Heat whenever any ally takes a hit, on top of the base gains.

oxp.limit: ×1.5, ignores all Defense, and the seat may swap position for the turn.
oxp.passive: Every kill restores Nerve in full instead of +30 and grants a Grow stack: +2% damage for the rest of the run, max ten. A second Emerald seat makes stacks +3%, a third +4%.

classes.name: Provider
classes.mirror: Taster: the Provider cares, the Taster scrutinises.
classes.weaponM: ♂ serving tongs with a cast-iron pan shield
classes.cue: ♂ plants the shield and raises the tongs in a serving salute; three cream dots gather above the pan. ♀ sets the pin upright and traces one warm ring at its barrel.
classes.desc: The caretaker at the front of the line: broad apron, crossed straps, three keys at the hip. The Provider holds the front and feeds whoever stands beside them. Every part of the kit is about serving; damage, protection and healing all come out of the pot.

kit.t: A tongs or rolling-pin swing that hits the target and one adjacent enemy.
Allies in adjacent slots take 10% less damage. Every 25 kills by the party, the Provider serves a bowl: the most-damaged adjacent ally heals 5%.
Slams the pot. Every ally heals 15% and every enemy in melee range is knocked back one tile.

cuts.name: Hearthfire
cuts.basic: The swing cleaves every enemy in a short arc and applies Burn ×1.
cuts.passive: Ration Ring instead gives adjacent allies +8% ATK; the Provider gains +2% ATK per Burning enemy on the field (max +30%).
cuts.signature: Boil Over. 180% to every enemy in melee range, Burn ×2, and the ground burns for 3 s at 8/s.

cuts.name: Head of the Table
cuts.basic: 2× threat and Chill ×1.
cuts.passive: Ration Ring is 15%, and the Provider takes what the allies don’t.
cuts.signature: Lock the Doors. A shield of 40% max HP and an ice wall one tile ahead for 3 s; enemies cannot pass it, and melee enemies that touch it are Frozen.

cuts.name: Stewpot
cuts.basic: Every 3rd swing serves a bowl instead: the most-damaged ally heals 8%.
cuts.passive: Ration Ring also regenerates adjacent allies 1% per second; every bowl served grants its ally +1% max HP for the fight (Grow).
cuts.signature: Second Helping heals 25% and grants every ally +5% max HP for the fight (Grow).

classes.name: Foodsmith
classes.motto: Every plate should carry a signature.
classes.mirror: Purist: the Foodsmith bursts, the Purist grinds.
classes.weaponM: ♂ straight chef’s knife, a body-height long
classes.cue: ♂ presents the knife flat on a palm; a cream plating stroke runs along its edge. ♀ holds the mezzaluna level; a plating arc pulses in its crescent.
classes.desc: Whites, a standing collar, one knife roll across the back. The Foodsmith does one thing perfectly and then does it again: every fourth cut is the Signature Strike, and the whole kit revolves around landing it in a crowd. Targets 1.8 is the average of three single cuts and one line crit.

kit.t: A knife or mezzaluna stroke. Every 4th is the Signature Strike: a guaranteed crit that hits every enemy in the line of the cut.
Starts the fight at 40 Heat. Every Signature Strike that kills refunds 10 Heat.
Dashes to the densest cluster and cuts through it for 200% in a line. A killing blow chains the cut to the next enemy, up to five.

cuts.name: Flambé
cuts.basic: Signature Strikes apply Burn ×2.
cuts.passive: Each chain kill gives +10% ATK for 3 s, stacking to three.
cuts.signature: Flourish leaves a fire trail: enemies crossing it take 60% and Burn ×1.

cuts.name: Showpiece
cuts.basic: 2× threat. Signature Strikes taunt every enemy they hit for 2 s.
cuts.passive: Above 70% HP the Foodsmith has +25% ARM; every crit taken gives +20 Heat.
cuts.signature: Showpiece. For 3 s the Foodsmith is the only legal target and takes −50%; when it ends, deals 100% of the damage taken to every attacker.

cuts.name: Consommé
cuts.basic: Each Signature Strike plates a Dish on the most-damaged ally. It bursts when they drop below 50% HP or after 3 s, healing 12% and cleansing one debuff.
cuts.passive: Every Dish that bursts makes future Dishes +1% stronger (Grow).
cuts.signature: Tasting Menu. A Dish on every ally, then Flourish at 120%.

classes.name: Spark
classes.mirror: Rebel: the Spark speeds allies, the Rebel disrupts enemies.
classes.weaponM: ♂ balloon whisk with five wire loops
classes.weaponF: ♀ linen piping bag, cradled in both hands
classes.cue: ♂ holds the whisk upright and turns it; three ochre seasoning dots gather above the balloon. ♀ lifts the nozzle and squeezes a small cream spiral.
classes.desc: Cropped jacket, two ribbon tails, a bandolier of spice shakers. The Spark gets everyone moving. Whatever the gem, allies beside the Spark are faster; the gem decides what the Spark does while they are.

kit.t: Spice from the whisk or piping bag at up to two enemies in mid range.
Adjacent allies gain +10% SPD. Every ally Signature gives the Spark +15 Heat.
The party gains +40% SPD for 4 s and +10 Heat.

cuts.name: Firecracker
cuts.basic: Hits three enemies; Burn ×1 on the primary.
cuts.passive: The Spark deals +10% to Burning enemies.
cuts.signature: While Start the Feast lasts, the Spark’s flings explode for 60% in a small area.

cuts.name: Centre Stage
cuts.basic: A tray-bash at mid range, 2× threat, Chill ×1.
cuts.passive: While two or more enemies target the Spark it takes −20% and Ignition is +15% instead of +10%.
cuts.signature: Spotlight. Every enemy in mid range attacks the Spark for 3 s; the Spark gains a 35% shield and adjacent allies +20 Heat.

cuts.name: Plus One
cuts.basic: Unchanged.
cuts.passive: Ignition also regenerates adjacent allies 1.5% per second. A Guest (150 HP, 12 ATK) joins in slot 6 at the bell and gains +5% all stats per 50 party kills (Grow).
cuts.signature: Toast. Every ally gains +10 Heat and +25% SPD for 3 s, and heals 3% per hit they land while it lasts.

classes.name: Gastronaut
classes.motto: Look where no one else is looking.
classes.mirror: Stirrer: the Gastronaut finds things, the Stirrer takes them.
classes.weaponM: ♂ two bamboo chopsticks carried as walking poles
classes.weaponF: ♀ spider strainer on a long bamboo handle
classes.cue: ♂ plants both chopsticks and lifts the head; three path-like cream dots rise between the sticks. ♀ presents the strainer level; three cream dots gather over the bowl.
classes.desc: Pack, creel, map tube and a three-tier tiffin. The Gastronaut fights from the back and brings things home: enemy deaths drop Ingredients the party eats for a permanent edge.

kit.t: A chopstick jab or strainer scoop at long range; +20% against the farthest enemy.
Enemies killed by anyone drop an Ingredient 10% of the time (Gastronaut kills 25%). The nearest cook eats it: +1% ATK for the fight (Grow), to +30%. Champions shower five.
Three shots at the three farthest enemies, 120% each.

cuts.name: Pepper
cuts.basic: Pierces one enemy behind the target.
cuts.passive: An eaten Ingredient Burns ×1 every enemy near where it fell.
cuts.signature: Volley applies Burn ×2 and gains one more shot per 250 party kills, up to six.

cuts.name: Lure
cuts.basic: 2× threat.
cuts.passive: Bramble Pack. Melee attackers take 15% of their damage back as thorns; enemies walking toward the Gastronaut are slowed 20%.
cuts.signature: Scent Lure. Every enemy on the field must attack the Gastronaut for 3 s along a thorn path that deals 20 per second to anything crossing it.

cuts.name: Herbalist
cuts.basic: Every 3rd shot instead drops a Herb Pouch on the most-damaged ally: a 6% heal and +1% max HP for the fight (Grow).
cuts.passive: Ingredients also heal the eater 5%.
cuts.signature: Seed Cache. Plants a cache in the back row that grows a stage every 5 s (max 5). At each Course boundary it bursts: every ally heals 4% and gains +2% all stats per stage (Grow).

classes.name: Taster
classes.motto: I test first, so others do not have to.
classes.mirror: Provider: the Taster scrutinises, the Provider cares.
classes.weaponM: ♂ pivot fan of three chef’s spoons
classes.cue: ♂ raises the spoon fan to the light; one amber dot pulses above the centre spoon. ♀ holds the microplane vertical and inspects a falling amber shaving.
classes.desc: One enlarged gauntlet, a diagonal row of vials, a loupe at the brow. The Taster marks what matters. Every cut Analyses the biggest threat in range so the whole party hits it harder; that mark is worth about four points of the budget, which is why the Taster’s own DPS is Support weight.

kit.t: A spoon or microplane throw at long range.
The highest-HP enemy in range is always Analysed: it takes +20% from the party. When it dies, the mark jumps to the next.
Every enemy within long range is Analysed for 5 s, and the Taster’s next five samples crit.

cuts.name: Hot Verdict
cuts.basic: Burn ×1.
cuts.passive: Burn ticks on Analysed enemies deal double.
cuts.signature: While Verdict lasts, every party hit on an Analysed enemy applies Burn ×1.

cuts.name: Inspector
cuts.basic: 2× threat.
cuts.passive: Under Inspection. Enemies attacking the Taster deal −15%; the Taster has +5% ARM per Analysed enemy alive, max +25%.
cuts.signature: Inspection. Every enemy in long range must attack the Taster for 3 s and has 0 ARM while doing so.

cuts.name: Antidote
cuts.basic: Poison 3 per second for 3 s; half the poison damage returns as healing to the most-damaged ally.
cuts.passive: Quality Control. Allies adjacent to the Taster are immune to Burn and poison; whenever an ally is cleansed by anyone they heal 5%.
cuts.signature: Remedy. Every ally is cleansed, heals 10% and is immune to debuffs for 3 s.

classes.name: Purist
classes.mirror: Foodsmith: the Purist grinds, the Foodsmith bursts.
classes.weaponM: ♂ long plating tweezers, gripped like a fencing tool
classes.weaponF: ♀ closed kitchen shears, one long point
classes.cue: ♂ closes the tweezer tips around one floating cream leaf and lifts it. ♀ opens and closes the shears around one floating cream thread.
classes.desc: An ankle-length wrap with one seam, a sealed case, the tool held away from the body. The Purist refuses: no debuff sticks and no strike misses. Targets 1.1 is the worth of never missing and ignoring a fifth of the armour.

kit.t: A tweezers or shears thrust that never misses and ignores 20% ARM.
Immune to every debuff: Burn, Chill, poison, stun, knockback and pulls.
For 4 s every Exact Cut deals true damage and executes enemies below 15% HP.

cuts.name: Clean Sear
cuts.basic: +10% ATK while above 80% HP.
cuts.passive: Kills refund 15 Heat.
cuts.signature: Clean Sear replaces The Standard: a 300% strike. If it kills, regain 100 Heat and strike the next target, chaining up to three.

cuts.name: Hold the Line
cuts.basic: 2× threat, Chill ×1.
cuts.passive: Standard. −10% damage taken per debuff on the attacker, max −30%.
cuts.signature: Hold the Line. For 3 s the Purist is immovable, takes −50%, and every enemy in melee range must attack it.

cuts.name: Preserve
cuts.basic: Every 3rd cut instead Preserves the most-damaged ally: a shield of 8% max HP.
cuts.passive: Sealed Case. Purist shields cannot be stripped and last until spent; an ally holding one is immune to Burn.
cuts.signature: Tradition. Every ally gains a 15% shield and +2% ARM for the fight (Grow). Nothing is ever healed by this cut; nothing gets through in the first place.

classes.name: Rebel
classes.mirror: Spark: the Rebel disrupts enemies, the Spark speeds allies.
classes.weaponF: ♀ stone mortar cradled in one arm, pestle in the other
classes.cue: ♂ taps the mallet by the communal pot; a cream ring appears above it. ♀ stirs the pestle and lifts a warm ring from the bowl.
classes.desc: A cropped academy jacket with three patches, a short sash, the communal pot on the hip. The Rebel gets in the way on purpose. Every cut reacts when an ally is in trouble; the gem decides how loud the reaction is.

kit.t: A mallet or pestle strike. Every 4th knocks the target back one tile.
When an ally drops below 30% HP, enemies attacking them must attack the Rebel for 2 s (once per ally every 20 s).
Every enemy in melee range is knocked back two tiles for 120%. Enemies knocked into others deal 60% to them.

cuts.name: Firebrand
cuts.basic: The 4th strike also applies Burn ×1.
cuts.passive: +20% ATK while any ally is below 50% HP.
cuts.signature: Kick the Table applies Burn ×2 and gives the Rebel +5% ATK per enemy hit for 5 s.

cuts.name: Barricade
cuts.basic: 2× threat.
cuts.passive: Human Shield. The taunt lasts 3 s and the Rebel has +20% ARM while it holds.
cuts.signature: Picket Line. Every enemy within a tile of melee must attack the Rebel for 3 s; when it ends, the Rebel deals 100% of the damage taken to every adjacent enemy.

cuts.name: Communal Pot
cuts.basic: Every 3rd strike instead Takes the Wound: the most-damaged ally heals 10% and the Rebel loses 5%.
cuts.passive: Share the Pot. The Rebel regenerates 2% per second while below 50% HP.
cuts.signature: Rally. Every ally below 50% heals 15% and gains +15% ATK for 4 s; the Rebel gains +4% max HP per ally rallied (Grow).

classes.name: Stirrer
classes.mirror: Gastronaut: the Stirrer takes things, the Gastronaut finds them.
classes.cue: ♂ tips the ladle in a controlled pour; one steam curl rises. ♀ circles the turner once from the wrist; one steam curl follows.
classes.desc: Half-apron over trousers, rolled sleeves, a headband with two tails. The Stirrer profits from the mess: every death on the field is a Leftover, and Leftovers are power. The Stirrer starts under budget and ends over it.

kit.t: A ladle sweep or turner flick at up to two enemies.
Every death on the field gives a Leftover stack (max 10): +1.5% ATK and +1.5% SPD each. Stacks decay one per 5 s without a kill.
Skewers at three random enemies for 110% each, plus one skewer per three Leftover stacks.

cuts.name: Skewer
cuts.basic: Burn ×1 on the second target.
cuts.passive: Each stack also gives +2% Burn damage.
cuts.signature: Skewers apply Burn ×1 and deal +50% to enemies already Burning.

cuts.name: Stall
cuts.basic: 2× threat, thrown from behind the folding stall.
cuts.passive: Folding Stall. Starts with a 20% shield that rebuilds 1% per Leftover stack gained; while it holds, adjacent allies take −10%.
cuts.signature: Slip Away. Vanishes for 2 s (every enemy attacking the Stirrer is Frozen), reappears with a 25% shield and throws the Toss.

cuts.name: Leftovers
cuts.basic: 40% of the damage is skimmed off and given as healing to the most-damaged ally.
cuts.passive: At every 50-kill milestone every ally heals 1% per Leftover stack.
cuts.signature: Leftovers. Consumes all stacks: allies heal 3% per stack and every three stacks spawn a Scrap (60 HP, 8 ATK) that fights until it dies.

classes.name: Host
classes.motto: The right seat can change a life.
classes.mirror: None. The Host sits in the middle and makes placement matter.
classes.weaponM: ♂ round metal turning peel on a long shaft
classes.cue: Keeps the peel planted and sweeps the cloth-bearing forearm in a gracious invitation; a small warm ring opens before the palm.
classes.desc: A tailcoat with two tails, a folded cloth over the forearm, three place cards at the breast. The Host makes the seating plan matter: something good passes between allies who stand together. The gem decides what.

kit.t: A peel thrust or thrown card that hits two enemies.
Allies in adjacent slots share 15% of any healing or shield either receives.
Swaps the most-damaged ally’s slot with the Host’s and shields the ally for 20% max HP.

cuts.name: Toast of the Table
cuts.basic: Unchanged.
cuts.passive: Adjacent allies also gain +8% ATK.
cuts.signature: Toast. Every ally’s next three attacks crit and Burn ×1, and the Host strikes the target for 200%.

cuts.name: Doorman
cuts.basic: 2× threat.
cuts.passive: The Host takes 30% of the damage dealt to adjacent allies and has +20% ARM.
cuts.signature: Guest of Honour. Links to the highest-ATK ally for 5 s: half their damage taken goes to the Host, their attacks crit, and the Host heals 5% per second.

cuts.name: Long Table
cuts.basic: Every 3rd card instead heals the most-damaged ally 6%.
cuts.passive: Sharing is 25%, and the Host heals 2% whenever an adjacent ally is healed by anyone.
cuts.signature: Long Table. A heal over time on every ally, 3% per second for 4 s; each cast adds +1% per second for the fight (Grow).
